register: # SOURCES: Afore T6 communication protocol (the 211208 spreadsheet Afore supplies to owners). The spreadsheet itself was not available, so every address was cross-checked between two independent public definitions: the Afore AF-SL hybrid Solarman definition (ozzzi/afore-power-flow-card, afore.yaml) and the evcc afore-hybrid template. Rows marked INFERRED rest on register layout only and need confirming against the spreadsheet.

# SERIAL: Modbus RTU over RS-485, 9600 baud, FC04 (input registers) for everything in this map. Set the inverter's RS485 protocol to Modbus in its menu first; default slave address 1. Older Afore BNT string inverters (T4 protocol) use a different layout; see afore_bnt_t4.

# SCOPE: single-phase AF-SL / AF-SL-1 hybrid, phase R only. 32-bit values are two registers, high word first at the lower address, so they need no endian adjustment. No signed or scaled value needed an adjustment: signs come from the SHORT / INT types and scales from the unit column.

# STATIC: the public definitions document no serial number, firmware version or rated-power register, so this map has no startup rows. No holding registers are documented either, so there is no holding map.
